Measure as published: The Fund calls for the revenue mobilisation plan to be accelerated: mining oversight, digitalisation, a standardised VAT invoice, a wider base
The Fund calls for the tax codes to be completed and provincial taxation harmonised
The Fund calls for fuel pricing reform and the removal of industrial exemptions and subsidies
The Fund calls for a public sector reform strategy and a national wage policy, urgently
Quantified target or date: Wage bill above 50 % of tax revenue

Measure as published: The Fund calls for the treasury single account and for spending authorisation to be decentralised to pilot ministries
The Fund calls for recurrent security spending to leave the emergency procedure and return to standard procedure
Quantified target or date: 17,4 % of spending under emergency procedure in 2025

Measure as published: The Fund calls for domestic arrears to be certified and tracked more frequently
The Fund calls for a careful, data-dependent easing cycle, held if the currency depreciates sharply
The Fund calls for faster conversion into dollars of the reserve requirements held in francs on foreign currency deposits
The Fund calls the law creating the economic and financial criminal court critical, and the anti-corruption bill to be tabled
The Fund calls exit from the financial action task force grey list critical to correspondent banking
The Fund calls for the strategic business climate plan, a VAT refund action plan, and a working tax mediation commission
The Bank sets out that resource revenue must be allocated more pro-poor, with more basic services, infrastructure and income opportunities
The Bank sets out that governance must be strengthened, conflict resolved, security restored and illicit resource flows curbed
